Title: TFGTRS-4592 - No payment method selected: order is rejected with the existing validation message - HB-UK, P8-UK, WH-UK
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Cookies accepted. A product in the bag. The fix stops the Adyen form processor from throwing and spamming the error log.
Steps:
1. Go through the checkout up to the payment step.
2. Do not select any payment method.
3. Click Place order.
Expected: The order is not placed. The existing validation message is shown (Hobbs: "Please Select A Payment method") and the user stays on the checkout without errors.

Title: TFGTRS-4592 - Business Manager logs after placing an order with no payment method
Pre-Condition: Business Manager access to the Development logs on dev. Run immediately after the previous test case so the log entries are easy to identify.
Expected: The error log has no new entries for the submission. The warn log has one new entry containing "no payment method selected".

Title: TFGTRS-4592 - Adyen card component with valid state data places the order - HB-UK, P8-UK, WH-UK
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Adyen test card only, never in production.
Steps:
1. Go through the checkout up to the payment step.
2. Select Credit / Debit Card and enter the Adyen test card.
3. Click Place order.
Expected: The payment is authorised and the order confirmation page is shown, as before the fix.

Title: TFGTRS-4592 - Info log still has the State Data entry after a card payment
Pre-Condition: Business Manager access to the Development logs on dev. Run right after a card order.
Expected: The entry "State Data - Append Payment Details" is still written.

Title: TFGTRS-4592 - Card method selected with empty or incomplete card data
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. Go through the checkout up to the payment step.
2. Select Credit / Debit Card but leave the card fields empty (or incomplete).
3. Click Place order.
4. Check the Adyen error log.
Expected: The order is rejected with a validation message and the error log is not flooded with "Cannot read property paymentMethod from null" or "Failed to parse payment form stateData".

Title: TFGTRS-4592 - Non-Adyen payment method is not affected (PayPal) - manual
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). PayPal sandbox account. Not covered by automation.
Steps: 1. Go through the checkout and pay with PayPal (sandbox).
Expected: The checkout works as before. The Adyen form processor is skipped and there are no new entries in the Adyen logs.
